sections.title: AI Chatbot Applications for Atlanta Organizations
sections.description: Production chatbot solutions for Atlanta's leading industries.

blocks.heading: Payments Technology Merchant and Customer Service Chatbots
paragraphs: For NCR (Atlanta HQ) and Global Payments (Atlanta HQ):

NCR merchant support chatbots: RAG chatbots for NCR's large retail and hospitality customer base — enabling merchants to ask natural language questions about NCR's POS systems, self-checkout maintenance, and payment processing integration without waiting for human support.

Global Payments developer chatbots: Technical documentation chatbots for Global Payments' developer ecosystem — answering API integration questions, troubleshooting payment flow issues, and guiding developers through payment gateway implementation.

Dispute and fraud inquiry chatbots: Automated chatbots handling merchant inquiries about disputed transactions, chargeback status, and fraud case resolution for Atlanta's large payment processor community.
Cost: $25,000–$80,000 | Timeline: 8–16 weeks | PCI DSS context

blocks.heading: Retail Customer Service Chatbots
paragraphs: For Home Depot (Atlanta HQ) and Kroger's large Atlanta retail presence:

Home Depot Pro chatbots: Contractor-focused chatbots for Home Depot's Pro customer community — product specification queries, bulk order assistance, project material calculation, and Pro loyalty program information for Home Depot's large contractor customer base.

DIY homeowner chatbots: Consumer-facing project guidance chatbots for Home Depot's large DIY homeowner audience — providing project guidance, product recommendations, and installation instructions for home improvement projects.
Grocery customer service: Chatbots for Kroger's Atlanta-area stores — store information, product availability, pharmacy queries, and loyalty program assistance for the Kroger Loyalty Plus community.
Cost: $25,000–$75,000 | Timeline: 8–16 weeks

blocks.heading: Airline Travel and Loyalty Chatbots
paragraphs: For Delta Air Lines (Atlanta HQ, the world's largest airline by market cap) and Atlanta's large travel industry:

Delta Sky Miles chatbots: Loyalty program chatbots for Delta's 100+ million SkyMiles members — mileage balance inquiries, award redemption guidance, status qualification questions, and benefit explanations for Delta's large loyalty membership.

Travel disruption chatbots: Real-time travel disruption information chatbots for Delta customers during irregular operations — rebooking guidance, delay explanations, and compensation information for disrupted passengers.

Customer operations chatbots: Internal chatbots for Delta's large customer-facing workforce — gate agent and flight attendant support tools providing instant access to policies, procedures, and customer service protocols.
Cost: $30,000–$85,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks | Aviation regulatory context

blocks.heading: Healthcare Navigation Chatbots
paragraphs: For Emory Healthcare, Children's Healthcare of Atlanta, and Grady Health:

Patient access chatbots: Appointment scheduling, symptom triage, and care navigation chatbots for Emory's and CHOA's large patient populations — handling inquiry volumes that would otherwise require significant human scheduling capacity.

Pediatric patient family chatbots: CHOA family-focused chatbots explaining pediatric conditions, treatment options, and care instructions for the parents and caregivers who are CHOA's effective patient-facing customer.
Health literacy chatbots: Accessible health information chatbots for Grady Health's diverse patient population — clear, jargon-free health information with appropriate literacy-level calibration.
Cost: $30,000–$85,000 | Timeline: 8–18 weeks | HIPAA BAA

blocks.heading: Financial Services Chatbots
paragraphs: For Ameris Bancorp, Equifax, and Atlanta's financial services community:

Credit inquiry chatbots: Equifax consumer service chatbots explaining credit scores, dispute processes, and identity protection services — handling the large volume of consumer credit inquiries that Equifax's large US consumer relationship generates.
Business banking chatbots: Internal and customer-facing chatbots for Ameris Bancorp's commercial banking operations — loan status, document requirements, and relationship banking support.
Cost: $25,000–$75,000 | Timeline: 8–16 weeks | FCRA, FINRA context
